Extreme Weather Events

Extreme Weather Events

Extreme weather events—including heatwaves, droughts, floods, tropical cyclones, and wildfires—have profound impacts on societies, ecosystems, and economies worldwide. This page provides a collection of operational tools and resources for monitoring ongoing events, analysing their meteorological drivers, assessing impacts, and exploring the influence of climate change.

🌍 Current Global Hazards

NASA Earth Observatory

Daily satellite imagery highlighting active wildfires, dust storms, volcanic eruptions, floods, and other remarkable events.

https://earthobservatory.nasa.gov/

NASA Worldview

Explore near real-time satellite imagery from MODIS, VIIRS and other sensors.

https://worldview.earthdata.nasa.gov/

GDACS — Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System

Real-time monitoring of floods, tropical cyclones, earthquakes, volcanic eruptions and wildfires.

https://www.gdacs.org/

Copernicus Emergency Management Service

European operational monitoring of floods, droughts, wildfires and emergency mapping.

https://emergency.copernicus.eu/

🌡 Heatwaves

Climate Shift Index (Climate Central)

Identifies where climate change has increased the likelihood of unusually warm temperatures.

https://www.climatecentral.org/climate-shift-index

NOAA HeatRisk

Forecast-based assessment of heat impacts across the United States.

https://www.wpc.ncep.noaa.gov/heatrisk/

🌊 Drought Monitoring

Global Drought Observatory

https://drought.emergency.copernicus.eu/

US Drought Monitor

https://droughtmonitor.unl.edu/

🌧 Flood Monitoring

Global Flood Awareness System (GloFAS)

https://global-flood.emergency.copernicus.eu/

Dartmouth Flood Observatory

https://floodobservatory.colorado.edu/

🌪 Tropical Cyclones

NOAA National Hurricane Center

https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/

Joint Typhoon Warning Center

https://www.metoc.navy.mil/jtwc/

🔥 Wildfires

FIRMS (NASA)

https://firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/

Provides near real-time active fire detections worldwide.

🌍 Climate Attribution

World Weather Attribution (WWA)

Rapid scientific assessments of the role of climate change in observed extreme events.

https://www.worldweatherattribution.org/

ClimaMeter

Near real-time attribution of extreme weather events using observations and climate model simulations.

https://www.climameter.org/

📊 Disaster Databases

EM-DAT

International Disaster Database.

https://www.emdat.be/

DesInventar

Disaster inventory system supported by UNDRR.

https://www.desinventar.net/
